Entries.OriginalFormat: There are 2 [ways to win|WINNING] in AtG:[BLANK-LINE][*] Conquering the [Capital City|CAPITAL] of one of the two [Roman Empire Factions|ROME].[BLANK-LINE][*] Becoming 'Magister Militum' and taking over [Rome|ROME] from within by sending five [Clans|CLAN] to become Roman Legions.[BLANK-LINE]Note that there are two Roman [Factions|FACTION]: the Eastern and Western halves of the previously-whole-in-better-days Roman Empire, and either one can satisfy your [Victory Conditions|WINNING].[BLANK-LINE]Conquering a Roman capital will require locating it on the map and significant military preparation. Although various setbacks will befall the Romans they start off quite strong and can put up quite a fight.[BLANK-LINE]Becoming Magister Militum is more of an economic victory, as to send a [Clan|CLAN] to [Rome|ROME] not only means sending it off for a year but also providing it with expensive, late-game equipment.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: AtG 中有 2 种[胜利方式|WINNING]：[BLANK-LINE][*]征服两个[罗马帝国派系|ROME]之一的[首都|CAPITAL]。[BLANK-LINE][*]成为“军务长官”，派出五个[氏族|CLAN]成为罗马军团，从内部接管[罗马|ROME]。[BLANK-LINE]注意，罗马有两个[派系|FACTION]：曾经统一而强盛的罗马帝国分裂为东西两半，征服任一方都能满足你的[胜利条件|WINNING]。[BLANK-LINE]征服罗马首都需要先在地图上找到它，并进行充分的军事准备。罗马会遭遇各种挫折，但开局依旧强大，能打出相当顽强的抵抗。[BLANK-LINE]成为军务长官更接近经济胜利，因为派一个[氏族|CLAN]前往[罗马|ROME]不仅要让其离开一年，还要提供昂贵的后期装备。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Caravans provide an opportunity to exchange [Resources|RESOURCE] you don't need for those you do.[BLANK-LINE]Caravans visit 3 times per year, in Late March, June, and September. Note that it does NOT  show up during the winter, so plan accordingly![BLANK-LINE]You can visit a Caravan by clicking the button at the top of the screen (after its arrived for the first time), clicking the Notification icon announcing its arrival, or presssing [HOTKEY:F2].
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 商队提供机会，让你用不需要的[资源|RESOURCE]交换急需的资源。[BLANK-LINE]商队每年到访 3 次，分别在三月下旬、六月和九月。注意，商队不会在冬季出现，请提前规划！[BLANK-LINE]商队首次抵达后，你可以点击屏幕顶部按钮、点击商队到达的通知图标，或按 [HOTKEY:F2] 拜访商队。

Entries.OriginalFormat: There are two distinct and independently-run Roman Empires. Both are quite strong in the early going, and picking a fight with them is very dangerous. In time you'll grow much stronger and the Romans weaker, but for now it's probably best to stay on their good side.[BLANK-LINE]Your [ultimate goal|WINNING] in AtG is to defeat the Romans by capturing the [Capital City|CAPITAL] of either half of the Empire, or take the empire over from within by becoming Magister Militum.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 世界上有两个彼此独立运作的罗马帝国。它们在前期都相当强大，贸然与其开战十分危险。随着时间推移，你会更强而罗马人会更弱；但眼下最好还是与他们保持良好关系。[BLANK-LINE]你在 AtG 中的[最终目标|WINNING]，是通过攻占帝国任一半部的[首都|CAPITAL]来击败罗马人，或成为军务长官，从内部接管帝国。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Factions are the different kinds of tribes, kingdoms, and empires to be found throughout the world.[BLANK-LINE]Different Factions all start in different situations, and are at different level of advancement, except for the human player, who always starts with a single [SETTLEMENT] and 3 [Clans|CLAN].[BLANK-LINE]You start the game only able to play as the Goths, but more can be unlocked by conquering the [Capital|CAPITAL] of another Faction, or forming an [Alliance|ALLIANCE] with it.[BLANK-LINE]Special, non-playable Factions include the [Romans|ROME], the [Bandits|BANDIT], and [Neutral|NEUTRAL] minor tribes.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 派系代表世界各地不同的部族、王国和帝国。[BLANK-LINE]不同派系开局形势和发展水平各不相同；人类玩家例外，总是以一个[SETTLEMENT]和3个[氏族|CLAN]开局。[BLANK-LINE]游戏开始时你只能扮演哥特人，但可以通过征服其他派系的[首都|CAPITAL]，或与其结成[同盟|ALLIANCE]来解锁更多派系。[BLANK-LINE]特殊的非可玩派系包括[罗马人|ROME]、[强盗|BANDIT]和[中立|NEUTRAL]小部族。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Borders, or Control, represents the [Tiles|TILE] which a player has direct ownership over and appears as a solid, colored line on the map.[BLANK-LINE]Control is very important, as within it your [Units|UNIT] always have full [Supply|SUPPLY], and it allows [Structures|STRUCTURE] to be [Constructed|CONSTRUCT], which far exceed foraging in their economic ouput.[BLANK-LINE]Control can be expanded by spending [WEAPONS] to [Fortify|FORTIFY] a Structure. [WATCHTOWER:S] are the one type of Structure which can be built outside of your Control, giving you the ability to project your power at a distance, should you be willing to make the investment.

Entries.OriginalFormat: Each [Tile|TILE] is comprised of at least one type of Terrain and some can have up to four or five.[BLANK-LINE][FERTILE:S], [DRY:S], and [DESERT:S] are 'base' Terrain types which can be found by themselves. Entries.OriginalFormat: [Clans|CLAN] increase in Level within a [Discipline|DISCIPLINE] based on how much [XP|XP] they have.[BLANK-LINE]As long as a Clan remains in a Profession within the same Discipline it will continue gaining Levels, but switching to a Profession in a different Discipline will reset that Clan back to Level 0.[BLANK-LINE]Upon reaching Level 10 a Clan can acquire 1 [Upgrade|UPGRADE] for free (the Upgrade must still first have been [Studied|LEARN]).[BLANK-LINE][Learning|LEARN] the initial Discipline [Tech|TECH] for each branch of the Tech Tree allows you to pick one of your Clans to give 2 free Levels in that Discipline, giving you a head start on [Training|TRAIN] them in associated [Professions|PROFESSION].

Entries.OriginalFormat: Advanced [STONE-BLOCKS:SINGULAR]-based [Structures|STRUCTURE] last forever, but their [Production|PRODUCE] can also be greatly increased by adding a [Clan|CLAN] in the same [Profession|PROFESSION] as the Clan which originally built it (e.g. more [FARMER:S] can be added to [Farms|FARM].[BLANK-LINE]To add an Apprentice to a Structure must have an available 'Apprentice Slot'. Structures start with 0, and you must spend [BOARDS] to add slots. Assigning an actual Clan then requires spending [PARCHMENT]. Entries.OriginalFormat: Each [Clan|CLAN] is made up of one or more Families. Each [Consumes|CONSUME] 0.1 [FOOD] per [Turn|TURN] (more on higher Difficulty Levels) and a new one joins every six months (12 Turns). As a game progresses your Food needs will continue accelerating, so always be thinking about how you're going to keep all of those hungry mouths fed![BLANK-LINE]Each additional Family which joins a Clan provides a 5% bonus to [Resource Production|PRODUCE] and [Combat Power|POWER], so while old, large Clans can be hard to feed they can also be quite useful in important roles.

Entries.OriginalFormat: Every [Clan|CLAN] has two Traits which shape which [Professions|PROFESSION] it's well-suited for, what kind of [Desires|DESIRE] it might develop, and generally how you'll want to use and manage it.[BLANK-LINE]Some Clans already start in Professions, making them useful but maybe hard to manage later when they don't want to switch [Disciplines|DISCIPLINE]. Other Clans might be inclined to commit [Crimes|CRIME], encouraging you to isolate them so they don't cause annoy anyone. There are around 100 Traits in AtG, so the number of possible combinations is quite large.

Entries.OriginalFormat: A [Clan's|CLAN] Mood is normally 'Content' but this can change if they develop a [Desire|DESIRE] or have a [Trait|CLAN-TRAIT] which alters their default Mood somehow.[BLANK-LINE]A happy Clan receives a bonus to [Resource Production|PRODUCE] and [Morale|MORALE], whereas unhappy Clans suffer a penalty to these.[BLANK-LINE]Clans can temporarily be made happier (and thus productive) by spending Alcohol. Entries.OriginalFormat: [Clans|CLAN] can develop a Desire based on their [Traits|CLAN-TRAIT], for example a Clan with the 'Easily Cold' Trait will likely [become unhappy|MOOD] if [Trained|TRAIN] as an [EXPLORER] and sent off during the winter.[BLANK-LINE]The longer a Clan has a Desire which hasn't been fulfilled the more their [Mood|MOOD] can drop. Ignoring a Clan's Desire can be done, but this is generally not advised. Satisfying a Clan's Desire will result in it receiving a permanent Mood bonus.[BLANK-LINE][Feuds|FEUD] are a special type of Desire where two Clans decide they hate each other and want you to [Punish|PUNISH] the other. Once a Feud has begun you will likely need to intervene.[BLANK-LINE]Most Clans will never develop a Desire, so this isn't something you'll need to spend too much time or energy dealing with. Pay attention to your Clans' Traits though, as some especially troublesome Clans are usually pretty easy to spot!

Entries.OriginalFormat: Feuds are a special kind of [Desire|DESIRE] that two [Clans|CLAN] develop together. When this occurs both Clans will start dropping in [Mood|MOOD] until you [Punish|PUNISH] one of them. Most of the time it makes the most strategic sense to Punish the less-useful Clan, but what you choose to do is a question of conscience for you alone!

Entries.OriginalFormat: [Clans|CLAN] with certain negative [Traits|CLAN-TRAIT] like 'Aggressive' or 'Rowdy' can sometimes commit a Crime. Entries.OriginalFormat: An Interaction is a single exchange between two Leaders. It might be a greeting, a threat, or a gift with a message. The types of Interactions an AI Leader chooses is based on their [Approach|APPROACH].

Entries.OriginalFormat: An Alliance is a permanent diplomatic arrangement which binds two [Factions|FACTION] together, and from that point on all wars either is engaged in will be joined by the other. A [Leader|LEADER] will agree to an Alliance if you have at least 5 [Leverage|LEVERAGE] with them.[BLANK-LINE]Forming an Alliance with a Faction is one of the two ways you can unlock that Faction for play in future games (the other being to conquer their [Capital|CAPITAL]).
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 同盟是一项永久外交安排，会将两个[派系|FACTION]绑定在一起；从此之后，任一方卷入的所有战争，另一方都会加入。若你与一位[领袖|LEADER]至少拥有 5 点[筹码|LEVERAGE]，对方就会同意结盟。[BLANK-LINE]与一个派系结盟，是在未来游戏中解锁该派系的两种方式之一（另一种是征服其[首都|CAPITAL]）。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Resources are the economic currency of AtG, and in conjunction with [Clans|CLAN] are essential to doing just about anything.[BLANK-LINE]There are two basic kinds of Resources: raw and refined. An example of a raw Resource is [IRON], which is [Harvested|HARVEST] from [Deposits|DEPOSIT] but can't actually be used for anything until refined into [WEAPONS] or [TOOLS].[BLANK-LINE]The most important Resource in the game is [FOOD], as without it your Clans will [Starve|STARVE]. [FAME] determines how often new Clans join you. [KNOWLEDGE] determines how fast you can [Study|STUDY] new [Professions|PROFESSION]. [TREASURE] is a versatile Resource that is especially useful for buying other Resources from [Caravans|CARAVAN]. [TIMBER] is required to [Construct|CONSTRUCT] basic [Structures|STRUCTURE], while [STONE-BLOCKS] are needed for more advanced versions which don't ever [Degrade|DEGRADE] and run out.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 资源是 AtG 的经济货币，与[氏族|CLAN]一起构成几乎一切行动的基础。[BLANK-LINE]资源分为两类：原料和加工品。[IRON]就是原料资源，可从[矿藏|DEPOSIT]中[采收|HARVEST]，但必须先精炼成[WEAPONS]或[TOOLS]才能真正使用。[BLANK-LINE]游戏中最重要的资源是[FOOD]，没有它，你的氏族会[挨饿|STARVE]。[FAME]决定新氏族加入的频率。[KNOWLEDGE]决定你[研究|STUDY]新[职业|PROFESSION]的速度。[TREASURE]用途广泛，尤其适合从[商队|CARAVAN]购买其他资源。[TIMBER]用于[建造|CONSTRUCT]基础[建筑|STRUCTURE]，更高级且不会[损耗|DEGRADE]枯竭的版本则需要[STONE-BLOCKS]。

Entries.OriginalFormat: [Resource|RESOURCE] production is a fundamental part of At the Gates.[BLANK-LINE]Initially you will simply [Harvest|HARVEST] them from [Deposits|DEPOSIT] with [Foragers|FORAGE] or buy them from the [Caravan|CARAVAN], but once your tribe is a bit more developed you'll be able to start refining raw Resources like [IRON] into other things like [TOOLS] with the help of [Professions|PROFESSION] like the [BLACKSMITH].[BLANK-LINE]Because you have a limited number of [Clans|CLAN] it's usually best to prioritize the production of one or two Resources rather than try to do everything.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: [资源|RESOURCE]生产是《At the Gates》的基础内容。[BLANK-LINE]一开始，你只需让[采集者|FORAGE]从[矿藏|DEPOSIT]中[采收|HARVEST]资源，或从[商队|CARAVAN]购买；但当部族稍有发展后，就能借助[BLACKSMITH]等[职业|PROFESSION]，把[IRON]之类原料精炼成[TOOLS]等物品。[BLANK-LINE]由于[氏族|CLAN]数量有限，通常最好优先生产一两种资源，而不是试图面面俱到。

Entries.OriginalFormat: [Resources|RESOURCE] can be consumed each [Turn|TURN] in two ways:[BLANK-LINE][*]Resources like [FOOD] are automatically consumed based on the number of [Clan|CLAN] [Families|FAMILY] you have.[BLANK-LINE][*]Raw Resources like [IRON] can be refined into more advanced things like [TOOLS] and are consumed in the process.[BLANK-LINE]The consumption of Resources by individual Clans can be disabled by clicking on that Clan in the Clans Screen and then clicking on the 'Stop Work' button. The consumption of 'special' [FOOD] Resources like [OLIVES] and [GRAPES] can be disabled by mousing over that Resource in your [Stockpile|STOCKPILE] and then clicking the 'Disable Substitution for Food' button.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: [资源|RESOURCE]每[回合|TURN]会以两种方式消耗：[BLANK-LINE][*][FOOD]等资源会根据你拥有的[氏族|CLAN][家庭|FAMILY]数量自动消耗。[BLANK-LINE][*][IRON]等原料资源可被精炼成[TOOLS]等高级物品，并在过程中消耗。[BLANK-LINE]若要禁止单个氏族消耗资源，可在氏族界面点击该氏族，再点击“停止工作”按钮。若要禁止[OLIVES]和[GRAPES]等“特殊”[FOOD]资源替代食物，可在[库存|STOCKPILE]中悬停该资源，然后点击“禁用食物替代”按钮。

Entries.OriginalFormat: You can [Produce|PRODUCE] raw [Resources|RESOURCE] from [Plant|PLANT] and [Mineral|MINERAL] [Deposits|DEPOSIT] in two ways: having a [Clan|CLAN] in certain [Professions|PROFESSION] [Forage|FORAGE] it (e.g. [DIGGER]), or by [Constructing|CONSTRUCT] certain [Structures|STRUCTURE] on it (e.g. [IRON-MINE-1]).[BLANK-LINE]Harvesting a Deposit gradually [Depletes|DEGRADE] and eventually exhausts it, after which it can no longer be Harvested. Nearly all Deposits can be Harvested for 18-24 [Turns|TURN] before running out (regardless of how much is actually being Produced) with the exact figure being determined by its type (e.g. 18 for [DEPOSIT-BEEHIVE:A/AN], 24 for [DEPOSIT-IRON:A/AN]).[BLANK-LINE][Animal Herds|ANIMAL] are the third type of Deposit, and function differently. Instead of being Harvested directly like Plants and Minerals Animals can either be Foraged by [HUNTER:A/AN] or [TRAPPER] to Produce [MEAT] or [PARCHMENT], or they can be added to your [Stockpile|STOCKPILE] by Constructing a [Pasture|PASTURE] on them.[BLANK-LINE]Animals in your Stockpile can be eaten directly for much more [FOOD] than a Hunter provides, and can also be used by [Settled|SETTLED] Professions like the [MEAT-CUTTER] and [PARCHMENT-MAKER] which Produce even more than that.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 你可以通过两种方式从[植物|PLANT]和[矿物|MINERAL][矿藏|DEPOSIT]中[生产|PRODUCE]原料[资源|RESOURCE]：让从事特定[职业|PROFESSION]的[氏族|CLAN]去[采集|FORAGE]（例如[DIGGER]），或在其上[建造|CONSTRUCT]特定[建筑|STRUCTURE]（例如[IRON-MINE-1]）。[BLANK-LINE]采收矿藏会逐渐使其[枯竭|DEGRADE]并最终耗尽，之后便无法再采收。几乎所有矿藏都能采收 18-24 个[回合|TURN]后才会耗尽（无论实际生产了多少），具体数值由类型决定（例如[DEPOSIT-BEEHIVE:A/AN]为 18，[DEPOSIT-IRON:A/AN]为 24）。[BLANK-LINE][动物群|ANIMAL]是第三类矿藏，运作方式不同。动物不能像植物和矿物那样直接采收；它们可以由[HUNTER:A/AN]或[TRAPPER]采集，以生产[MEAT]或[PARCHMENT]，也可以通过在其上建造[牧场|PASTURE]加入你的[库存|STOCKPILE]。[BLANK-LINE]库存中的动物可以直接食用，提供远多于猎人的[FOOD]；也可以供[定居|SETTLED]职业使用，例如[MEAT-CUTTER]和[PARCHMENT-MAKER]，其产出会更高。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Your stockpile of [Resources|RESOURCE] is visible on the left side of the World Screen. Once 'in the bank' you can save Resources for future purposes, or trade them away at the [Caravan|CARAVAN] for other Resources you need.[BLANK-LINE][FOOD] is a special type of Resource that other kinds of Resources like [WHEAT] and [GRAPES] automatically turn into when [Produced|PRODUCE]. [FOOD] also enters your stockpile as ['Stored Turns'|STORED-TURN], rather than a specific quantity like other Resources.

Entries.OriginalFormat: If you have at least 24 [FOOD] in your [Stockpile|STOCKPILE] then a percentage of any further [Production|PRODUCE] will start to 'spoil'. The initial penalthy is -50%, and every every additional 12 [FOOD] another half of the remaining Production will be lost. Storing up large quantities of [FOOD] can provide security but isn't the most efficient way to run your economy.

Entries.OriginalFormat: Your [SETTLEMENT] is able to Train one [Clan|CLAN] at a time, and usually in a [Profession|PROFESSION]. Entries.OriginalFormat: It is said that states never truly die, that they simply change into something else. And while this is true, it misses the fact that for many the story is what matters. It mirrors our own fears, of change and of inevitable death. While the tale of the fall of Rome may not perfectly capture historical reality it's still a story that's important because of the meaning we find in it, and how historical narratives can be used both to inspire and control.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 据说国家从未真正死亡，只是转化为另一种形态。这固然有道理，却忽略了对许多人而言，故事本身才最重要。它映照出我们对变化与必然死亡的恐惧。罗马陷落的传说未必完全符合历史现实，但它仍因我们赋予的意义而重要，也因为历史叙事既能激励人，也能控制人。

Entries.OriginalFormat: Violence is a pillar of human history. We are fundamentally a tribal species, and the simplest and most direct way tribes communicate is with blood. Study the birth of any human society, going back hundreds of thousands of years, and you will always find violence. And just as civilizations are born in blood they also die in blood. In the end all empires must fall. For there to be life there must also be death.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 暴力是人类历史的支柱。我们本质上是部族性物种，部族之间最简单、最直接的交流方式就是流血。研究任何人类社会的诞生，哪怕追溯到数十万年前，你总能看到暴力。文明诞生于鲜血，也死于鲜血。最终，一切帝国都将倾覆。有生必有死。

Entries.OriginalFormat: There are 2 [ways to win|WINNING] in AtG:[BLANK-LINE][*] Conquering the [Capital City|CAPITAL] of one of the two [Roman Empire Factions|ROME].[BLANK-LINE][*] Becoming 'Magister Militum' and taking over [Rome|ROME] from within by sending five [Clans|CLAN] to become Roman Legions.[BLANK-LINE]Note that there are two Roman [Factions|FACTION]: the Eastern and Western halves of the previously-whole-in-better-days Roman Empire, and either one can satisfy your [Victory Conditions|WINNING].[BLANK-LINE]Conquering a Roman capital will require locating it on the map and significant military preparation. Entries.OriginalFormat: Your top priority during your first year is finding a reliable source of [FOOD] you can [Forage|FORAGE] for before winter arrives. Acquiring other [Resources|RESOURCE] such as [TIMBER] can also be quite useful, as this will allow you to start building [Structures|STRUCTURE].

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Any text which has a red drop shadow may be moused over to reveal additional information.

		Any user interface element that is gold-colored is clickable. Sometimes mousing over something in the UI will cause buttons to apepar.

		Some of the more advanced tooltips in the game (such as those for [Professions|PROFESSSION] can be customized. Clicking on the thin gold bars allows you to expand hidden sections, and the buttons in the upper-right corner of a section allow you to minimize or hide it.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 任何带有红色投影的文本都可以用鼠标悬停查看额外信息。任何金色用户界面元素都可以点击。有时鼠标悬停在界面元素上会使按钮出现。游戏中一些更高级的提示框（例如[职业|PROFESSSION]提示框）可以自定义。点击细金条可以展开隐藏部分，而某个部分右上角的按钮可以最小化或隐藏它。

Entries.OriginalFormat:

		Being in an [Active Profession|ACTIVE] allows a [Clan|CLAN] to perform actions on the map, such as fighting or [Harvesting Resources|HARVEST]. Entries.OriginalFormat:
The most important buttons in the interface are in the upper-right corner of the screen.

		The button which looks like a big house takes you to the 'Clan Management Screen'. This is the hub of your tribe, and the most important screen in the game.

		Other buttons in this area allow you to expand your tribe's [Clan Limit (popcap)|POPCAP], and modify which [Profession|PROFESSION] you're currently [Studying|STUDY] and [Training|TRAIN] a Clan in.

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Because AtG is still in development, full diplomacy has not yet been implemented. You can't make agreements with other kingdoms, and they won't yet declare war on you, though other Leaders will say hello from time to time.

		That said, this doesn't mean YOU can't declare war though! Feel free to do so in the Diplomacy Screen ([HOTKEY:Ctrl-D]) if you're itching for a fight.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 因为 AtG 仍在开发中，完整外交尚未实现。你不能与其他王国达成协议，他们也还不会向你宣战，不过其他领袖会不时来打招呼。话虽如此，这并不意味着你不能宣战！如果你渴望战斗，可以在外交界面（[HOTKEY:Ctrl-D]）随意这么做。

The game also has several hotkeys to assist in navigating the interface, which will appear when mousing over a button that has a corresponding key.

		The most important keys are the spacebar, which opens the [Clans|CLAN] Screen, and ENTER, which ends the turn or activates the next unresolved high-priority notification.

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Hills are a minor [Terrain|TERRAIN] obstacle.

		[*]Costs 1 additional [Move Point|MOVE-POINT] to enter.
		[*]Reduces the [Supply|SUPPLY] available to [Units|UNIT] by 1.
		[*]Grants a 25% [Defense|DEFENSE] bonus.
		[*]Blocks [Vision|VISION], unless...

		Standing [COLOR:EMPHASIS]on[/COLOR] a Hill makes it possible to see over [Forests|FOREST] and other Hills, making them ideal Tiles for [EXPLORER:S] to visit while exploring.

		Hills can also contain valuable [Minerals|MINERAL] like [DEPOSIT-IRON:S] and [DEPOSIT-STONE:S].
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 丘陵是一种轻微[地形|TERRAIN]障碍。[*]进入时额外消耗 1 点[移动点数|MOVE-POINT]。[*]使[单位|UNIT]可用[补给|SUPPLY]减少 1。[*]提供 25% [防御|DEFENSE]加成。[*]会阻挡[视野|VISION]，除非……站在丘陵[COLOR:EMPHASIS]上[/COLOR]可以越过[森林|FOREST]和其他丘陵观察，因此探索时很适合让[EXPLORER:S]前往。丘陵也可能含有[DEPOSIT-IRON:S]、[DEPOSIT-STONE:S]等珍贵[矿物|MINERAL]。

Entries.OriginalFormat: [Founding your Kingdom|DECLARE-KINGDOM] is a big step, and costs 20 Parchment. This is an action you probably won't be ready for until at least turn 50 - before this your goal is simply to explore the map and develop your economy in order to open up larger strategic plays in the midgame.

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Your high-level goals in the first few turns of the game are:

		[*] Revealing the map around you with an [EXPLORER] in order to find [Abandoned Ruins|DESERTED-LOCATION] (which often contain useful items) and [Resource Deposits|DEPOSIT] you can [Harvest|HARVEST].

		[*] [Training|TRAIN] [Clans|CLAN] as [Foragers|FORAGE] in order to [Harvest Deposits|HARVEST] you already know about.

Entries.OriginalFormat: The most important screen in the game besides the World Screen is the [Clans|CLAN] Screen. You can press the spacebar to open or close it. This screen shows you all of the [Clans|CLAN] in your [SETTLEMENT], which you can [Train|TRAIN] in various [Professions|PROFESSION]. It also includes a few important but rare tribe-level actions, such as [Founding a Kingdom|DECLARE-KINGDOM]. You'll spend a lot of time in this screen!

Entries.OriginalFormat:
The 3 most important screens in the game are the [Clans|CLAN] Screen, the [Training|TRAIN] Screen, and the [Research|STUDY] Screen. The latter two both show the "tree" of the [Professions|PROFESSION] that [Clans|CLAN] can be [Trained|TRAIN] in (once [Researched|LEARN]).

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Your [Clans|CLAN] are the main building block of your tribe. You start with 3 and will end a (successful!) game with more than 40.

		Each [Clan|CLAN] can be [Trained|TRAIN] in a [Profession|PROFESSION], which allows it to [Produce Resources|PRODUCE], do something on the map as a [Unit|UNIT], like fight and explore, or provide some other effect.

Entries.OriginalFormat:
There are 3 types of [Resources|RESOURCE]: [Plants|PLANT], [Animals|ANIMAL], and [Minerals|MINERAL]. Each is useful in different ways.

		[Harvesting Resources|HARVEST] is important, but you'll eventually want to also Refine them into more advanced [Resources|RESOURCE] (such as [IRON] into [WEAPONS], or [WOOL] into [CLOTH]). Many [Professions|PROFESSION] you can unlock though [Research|STUDY] relate to [Resource|RESOURCE] refinement, so refer to the tree for ideas on what strategies you can pursue.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: [资源|RESOURCE]有 3 类：[植物|PLANT]、[动物|ANIMAL]和[矿物|MINERAL]。每一类都有不同用途。[采收|HARVEST]很重要，但你最终也会想把它们精炼成更高级的[资源|RESOURCE]（例如把[IRON]变成[WEAPONS]，或把[WOOL]变成[CLOTH]）。许多可通过[研究|STUDY]解锁的[职业|PROFESSION]都与[资源|RESOURCE]精炼有关，因此可以查看科技树来构思可行策略。

Entries.OriginalFormat: There are several places in the game where you can write small notes to yourself to keep track of things. Entries.OriginalFormat:
In addition to its [Profession|PROFESSION] a [Clan|CLAN] can have a [Discipline|DISCIPLINE], and can gain [Experience|XP] and [Levels|LEVEL] in it. This mostly determines how long it takes to [Train|TRAIN] the [Clan|CLAN] in a new [Profession|PROFESSION] (those in the same [Discipline|DISCIPLINE] are much faster), but a [Clan|CLAN]'s [Mood|MOOD] might be affected as well based on its [Personality Traits|CLAN-TRAIT].

		Each [Clan|CLAN] has 2 [Personality Traits|CLAN-TRAIT], which can be good, bad, or simply something to plan around.

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Forests are a major [Terrain|TERRAIN] obstacle which can be [Harvested|HARVEST] for [TIMBER].

		[*]Lose [COLOR:EMPHASIS]all[/COLOR] remaining [Move Points|MOVE-POINT] after entering.
		[*]Reduces the [Supply|SUPPLY] available to [Units|UNIT] by 1.
		[*]Grants a 25% [Defense|DEFENSE] bonus.
		[*]Blocks [Vision|VISION] (unless standing on a nearby [HILL]).

		Forests are also the only source of [TIMBER], a [Resource|RESOURCE] needed to [Construct|CONSTRUCT] [Structures|STRUCTURE], and therefore vital for most of the game.

		Forests should not be confused with the more easily-traversed but Timber-less [BRUSH-LEAFY].
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 森林是主要[地形|TERRAIN]障碍，可以被[采收|HARVEST]以获得[TIMBER]。[*]进入后失去[COLOR:EMPHASIS]全部[/COLOR]剩余[移动点数|MOVE-POINT]。[*]使[单位|UNIT]可用[补给|SUPPLY]减少 1。[*]提供 25% [防御|DEFENSE]加成。[*]会阻挡[视野|VISION]（除非站在附近的[HILL]上）。森林也是木材的唯一来源，而[TIMBER]是[建造|CONSTRUCT][建筑|STRUCTURE]所需的[资源|RESOURCE]，因此在大部分游戏阶段都很关键。不要把森林与更易穿越但没有木材的[BRUSH-LEAFY]混淆。

Entries.OriginalFormat:
After you've developed your economy a bit and found a region with several [Deposits|DEPOSIT] you'd like to [Harvest|HARVEST] forever you can use the ['Found Kingdom'|DECLARE-KINGDOM] command in the [Clans|CLAN] Screen.

		This permanently glues your [SETTLEMENT] to whatever Tile it's currently on, but provides it a large increase in its [Control Level|CONTROL] ([Borders|BORDERS]) and you a large boost in [FAME] (helping you acquire new [Clans|CLAN] faster).

Entries.OriginalFormat: Each Turn represents half a month, and eventually it will become [Winter|COLD]. Entries.OriginalFormat:
For the most part you can use the map to guide your strategic decisions. Whatever [Resource Deposits|DEPOSIT] are available nearby should usually become the foundation of your economy, as even things you don't need can be traded for what you lack when a [Caravan|CARAVAN] is visiting.

		At the very least you'll want a [HUNTER], [GATHERER], or [REAPER] soon, before [winter's chill|SEASON] takes hold.
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 在很大程度上，你可以用地图来引导战略决策。附近可用的任何[资源矿藏|DEPOSIT]通常都应成为经济基础，因为即便是你不需要的东西，也能在[商队|CARAVAN]到访时交易成你缺少的东西。至少，你很快会想要一个[HUNTER]、[GATHERER]或[REAPER]，赶在[冬寒|SEASON]降临之前。

Entries.OriginalFormat:

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Trudging through deep snow is not easy, and [Armies|ARMY] which try will quickly bog down.

		On the bright side, the [Rivers|RIVER] and [MARSH:S] that normally act as significant barriers become easy to cross once frozen, so don't be afraid to take advantage of new opportunities.

		That said, winters can be harsh - don't be caught unprepared!
Entries.LocalizedFormat: 在深雪中跋涉并不容易，尝试这样做的[军队|ARMY]很快会陷入困境。好的一面是，一旦结冰，通常构成重大障碍的[河流|RIVER]和[MARSH:S]会变得容易穿越，所以不要害怕利用新机会。话虽如此，冬季可能很残酷，别毫无准备地被它抓住！

Entries.OriginalFormat:
Each [Unit|UNIT] has a certain amount of [Move Points|MOVE-POINT], which determines how far it can move in a Turn. Tiles with clear, flat [Terrain|TERRAIN] cost 1 [Move Point|MOVE-POINT] to enter and most [Units|UNIT] have 3 to spend each Turn.

		[Units|UNIT] also require [Supply|SUPPLY] from their Tile, and will lose [Morale|MORALE] and [Health|HEALTH] if the [Supply|SUPPLY] provided by a Tile is less than what they need (this is usually caused by changes in [Season|SEASON] or [Weather|WEATHER]).

Entries.OriginalFormat:

Entries.OriginalFormat: [Health|HEALTH] is another important stat. It starts at 100 and if it reaches 0 a [Unit|UNIT] dies. As it drops it also lowers a Unit's [Power|POWER]. Entries.OriginalFormat:
The [Control Level|CONTROL] of a [Structure|STRUCTURE] or [SETTLEMENT] is equal to the [Border|BORDERS] distance, and this can be upgraded by spending [WEAPONS] to [Fortify|FORTIFY] it. The cost of doing so increases each time though, so only do so strategically.

		Note that [Foragers|FORAGE] may [Harvest Resources|HARVEST] from any Tile on the map, regardless of whether or not it's inside your [Borders|BORDERS] - don't forget that they still need [Supply|SUPPLY] though!

Entries.OriginalFormat:
[Warrior Units|WARRIOR] have a few important stats.

		First is [Power|POWER], which is a general metric of how strong a [Unit|UNIT] is in combat. In general, one Unit or [Stack of Units|STACK] with double the [Power|POWER] of another will beat up their foe but not quite kill them. Rules.Description: Concept hover text is registered from literal, concatenated, and XML-key operands in the Concepts static constructor, then localized at the final rich-text display boundary.
Knowledge tooltip upgrade cost fragment; IL rewrite avoids padding.
Generic hotkey tooltip shown when hovering [HOTKEY:*] tags inside UI tooltips.
Knowledge detail panel research status prefix; combines with localized [Study|STUDY].
Generated from existing UI hardcoded maps and ldstr catalog to avoid equal-length padding.
Argument-only and non-linguistic composite operands need no display template; registering an all-argument template would match unrelated text.
Only concept-link display text changes; the concept key remains intact.
Exact final display strings are localized without token rewriting.
Legacy display fragments are applied only after the final rich-text boundary.
Plain final display strings are localized at the rich-text display boundary.
Scoped rich-text fragments are replaced before parsing so their concept keys and recursive hovers remain intact.
